correctness.rationale: For unit ℓ1-octahedron and fixed u=(1,1,1)/sqrt3, exactly enumerated all 56 triples of eight translated facet planes symbolically and found 12 affine vertices valid throughout t in (0,2/3); independently convex-hull volume at six interior t verified (2-3t)(4-3t)/6, and examined checker shoelace formulas. Facet-pyramid identities give directional g(r)=4/3−√3r+r²/2 to rmax=2/√3, otherwise zero. Fubini g(r)=∫(L−r)+dy and -g’(r)/projection area yields continuous survival 1−r/√3 and endpoint atom 1/3. Moment integration gives E L=4/(3√3), Var(L)=4/27. Endpoint/zero-offset and selection measure explicit; numeric checks corroborate but do not replace symbolic phase proof.
residual_risks: Exact finite verification cannot imply an unasserted parametrized generalization; all conclusions bounded as stated.
